text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian enjoys a splendid victory at the Arima Kinen. Biwa Hayahide is blown away by her younger sister's performance and expresses her admiration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun asserts that she'll win next time in no uncertain terms. Biwa Hayahide says the same—it seems there is no shortage of competitors to face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian is far from satisfied. Thinking of the future and competing against the next generation of racers, she has a tremendous urge to run.
